```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Safety check: if running outside Binder without chinook.sqlite, download it automatically
if (!dir.exists("data")) dir.create("data")
if (!file.exists("data/chinook.sqlite")) {
  download.file(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpwhite3/northwind-SQLite3/main/dist/northwind.db",
    destfile = "data/northwind.db",
    mode = "wb"
  )
}
```

## Connect to data/northwind.db in your .Rmd

In your project .Rmd file (at the repo root alongside Week01_SQL_to_R_Chinook.Rmd), connect using DBI and RSQLite:

```{r connect-db}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(tidyverse)
library(dbplyr)

# Connect to the Chinook SQLite file
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/northwind.db")

# List all tables in the database (these should look familiar!)
dbListTables(con)
```

__Schema quirk to watch out for (`Order Details`)__

In [jpwhite3/northwind-SQLite3](https://github.com/jpwhite3/northwind-SQLite3/tree/main), the line-items table is named `Order Details` with a space:

 - In raw SQL (`dbGetQuery()` or `{sql connection=con}` chunks), wrap it in double quotes or brackets:

```
dbGetQuery(con, '
  SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, od.ProductID, od.UnitPrice, od.Quantity, od.Discount
  FROM Orders AS o
  JOIN "Order Details" AS od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
  LIMIT 10
')
```

 - In `dbplyr`, `tbl()` quotes it automatically:

```
orders_tbl        <- tbl(con, "Orders")
order_details_tbl <- tbl(con, "Order Details")

orders_tbl |>
  inner_join(order_details_tbl, by = "OrderID") |>
  collect()
```

Remember to include `dbDisconnect(con)` in a final cleanup chunk so __Knit -> Publish to RPubs__ closes cleanly.

## 🌐 How to Publish to RPubs & Submit Your URL on Canvas

Follow these steps to publish your finished lab report to **[RPubs.com](https://rpubs.com/)** and get your submission link for Canvas:

1. **Add Your Name**: At the very top of this file (Line 3), replace `[Type Your Name Here]` with your actual name and save (`Ctrl+S` / `Cmd+S`).
2. **Click the Green `▶` Play Button on the Code Chunk Below**:
   - It will automatically knit your report to HTML, upload it to **RPubs.com**, and print a **`http://rpubs.com/publish/claim/...`** link right below the box!
3. **Click That Link**:
   - It will open **RPubs.com** in a new tab (sign in or create a free account if this is your first lab, then click **Continue**).
   - Copy your final `https://rpubs.com/your_username/...` URL from your browser's address bar and paste it into **Canvas**!

```{r publish-to-rpubs, eval=FALSE}

# Step 2: Upload the HTML report directly to RPubs.com
```
